body: thanks for the PR!  I added some short guidance.

**Gord Thompson** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **master** branch:

**Reflect comments from any table accessible by the current user** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/1776

**Gord Thompson** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **master** branch:

**Reflect comments from any table accessible by the current user** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/1776

**Gord Thompson** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **rel_1_3** branch:

**Reflect comments from any table accessible by the current user** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/1777
this is not working correctly.  we changed the query to use all_tab_comments but we aren't qualifying the table name with the owner.

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **master** branch:

**Include schema in all_tab_comments query** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/1791

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **rel_1_3** branch:

**Include schema in all_tab_comments query** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/1792

> *this is not working correctly. we changed the query to use all_tab_comments but we aren't qualifying the table name with the owner.*

Right, that would makes sense. Thanks for catching/fixing that @zzzeek!
well the alembic builds are failing on it because they reflect the same table name from multiple schemas simultaneously.

I guess a job that tests alembic in the sqlachemy jenkins could be useful?

Edit: I guess more than one would be useful, since more than one backend should be tested.

yeah we need that pretty badly.    it doesn't have to be a matrix job though; alembic's test suite does all the backends in one go.   we can make it just for py37 and that's it.   we would need a script that does the thing where it looks at the GERRIT variables to get the correct SQLAlchemy version into a local virtual environment.  the openstack.sh script is a much more complicated example of this.

issue.title: Add alembic tests in the sqlalchemy jenkins matrix
issue.body: Alembic should be tested against each patch of sqlalchemy, since sometimes it can reveal bugs that are not caught by the sqlalchemy test soute, like in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/issues/5146
